new_result.name: QFORM-NEARNULL-CROSSCURVATURE-IDENTITY-v1
new_result.statement: For exact rank three A=UMU^T and heavy physical direction r, with a=r^TMr, k=Mr, kappa=||k||, the compression C of M to (Mr)^perp satisfies det(C)=a det(M)/kappa^2. In the indefinite target one compressed eigenvalue has magnitude at least 1 by interlacing, while ||P_(r^perp)Mr||^2=kappa^2-a^2>=1-a^2.
new_result.meaning: Near a=0 the only new degenerating curvature is one compressed eigenvalue; the hub-transverse star stays uniformly strong.
